sources.snippet: Overview sam2.1-hiera-large is a promptable visual segmentation foundation model developed by facebook that segments objects in both images and videos from text, point, or bounding box prompts. The model uses a hierarchical vision transformer architecture (Hiera) and outputs multiple mask predictions ranked by quality score for each prompt.
